author: Aaron
name: FortniteStats
short: Fortnite stat cards, a browsable item shop, wishlists and news.
description: Self-hosted Fortnite cog powered by fortnite-api.com. Custom stat cards with Lifetime/Season and input toggles (Epic, PlayStation and Xbox names), head-to-head compares and a server leaderboard. The item shop posts as a clean cover image with a private section-by-section browser, plus item lookups with shop history and wishlist pings in the daily shop post.
install_msg: Thanks for installing FortniteStats! Get a free API key at https://dash.fortnite-api.com, then run `[p]fnset apikey <key>` in DMs. Set the daily shop with `[p]fnset shopchannel #channel`.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores your linked Fortnite account name/ID and your item wishlist, keyed by your Discord user ID. Use `[p]fn unlink` and `[p]fn wishlist clear` to remove them.
